items.title: Elf Looking Through a Brass Telescope
items.alt: Blond-curled cartoon elf in green overalls looking through a brass telescope on a complete wooden tripod.
items.description: One hand rests near the telescope's focusing knob while the elf peers through the eyepiece. Green short overalls, a red shirt and red curled shoes make a compact stargazing character.

items.title: Elf Stepping Under a Leaf Umbrella
items.alt: Braided cartoon elf in a green dress holding a broad leaf umbrella and lifting one red shoe above a tiny puddle.
items.description: Water droplets cling to the large leaf above the elf's zigzag hat. A cream-edged green dress and two dark braids accompany the playful stepping pose.

items.title: Elf Waving with a Teal Gift
items.alt: Blue-eyed cartoon elf in green overalls waving one hand and carrying a teal Christmas gift with a red bow.
items.description: A lifted knee and open waving hand give this greeting character a lively silhouette. Brown curled shoes and a red shirt contrast with the long green overalls.

items.title: Elf Stirring a Copper Soup Pot
items.alt: Freckled cartoon elf in a green tunic stirring a small steaming copper pot on a low wooden stump.
items.description: Both hands hold the long wooden spoon above the colorful soup. A red sash, cream cuffs and buckled brown shoes distinguish the standing kitchen helper.

items.title: Elf Stitching a Curled Green Boot
items.alt: Copper-curled cartoon elf seated on a gift box, stitching a large green boot held on a little wooden stand.
items.description: A red seam runs up the boot's side beneath its red bow and gold bells. The elf guides the needle and thread in a cream-trimmed green coat and red curled shoes.

items.title: Felt Christmas Elf Sewing Kit
items.alt: Green-clothed felt elf ornament arranged with green fabric, a thread spool, a blunt needle and an embroidery hoop.
items.description: Visible stitches edge the little elf's coat, cap and curled shoes. A complete hanging loop rises above its head, with sewing materials arranged on either side.
